人生就像一场旅行，不在乎目的地，最重要的是沿途的风景。
生活不是等待风暴过去，而是学会在雨中跳舞。
每一个不曾起舞的日子，都是对生命的辜负。
Always has the heart of an apprentice!
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
千里之行，始于足下。
Life is 10% what happens to us and 90% how we react to it.
生活是10%发生在我们身上的事，90%是我们如何应对。
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
困难中藏着机会。
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
种树最好的时间是20年前，其次是现在。
Believe you can and you're halfway there.
相信你能做到，你已经成功了一半。
Success is not final, failure is not fatal: It is the courage to continue that counts.
成功不是终点，失败也不是终结，真正重要的是继续前进的勇气。
Happiness is not something ready made. It comes from your own actions.
幸福不是现成的，它来自你的行动。
The only limit to our realization of tomorrow is our doubts of today.
实现明天理想的唯一障碍是今天的疑虑。
Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
在你所处的地方，用你所有的资源，做你能做的事。
Life is either a daring adventure or nothing at all.
生活要么是一场大胆的冒险，要么什么都不是。
The purpose of our lives is to be happy.
我们生活的目的是为了快乐。
You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
你不尝试，就100%错过了机会。
It's not whether you get knocked down, it's whether you get up.
重要的不是你被击倒，而是你是否能重新站起来。
The best revenge is massive success.
最好的报复是巨大的成功。
Your time is limited, don't waste it living someone else's life.
你的时间有限，不要浪费在过别人的生活上。
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
做出伟大工作的唯一方法是热爱你所做的事。
If you look at what you have in life, you'll always have more.
如果你看看你生活中拥有的，你总会拥有更多。
Life is really simple, but we insist on making it complicated.
生活其实很简单，但我们坚持把它复杂化。
The mind is everything. What you think you become.
思想就是一切。你想什么，你就会成为什么。
The best and most beautiful things in the world cannot be seen or even touched - they must be felt with the heart.
世界上最好和最美的东西是看不见甚至摸不着的，它们必须用心去感受。
Keep your face always toward the sunshine - and shadows will fall behind you.
永远面向阳光，阴影就会落在你身后。
It is during our darkest moments that we must focus to see the light.
正是在我们最黑暗的时刻，我们必须集中精力看到光明。
Whoever is happy will make others happy too.
快乐的人也会使别人快乐。
Don't judge each day by the harvest you reap but by the seeds that you plant.
不要以你收获的多少来判断每一天，而要以你播种的多少来判断。
The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
唯一真正的智慧是知道你一无所知。
The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
开始的方法是停止说话，开始行动。
It always seems impossible until it's done.
在完成之前，一切似乎都是不可能的。
Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
表现得好像你所做的有所作为。确实如此。
The best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today.
对明天最好的准备就是今天做到最好。
You can't use up creativity. The more you use, the more you have.
创造力是用不完的。你用得越多，你拥有的就越多。
Dream big and dare to fail.
大胆梦想，敢于失败。
What we think, we become.
我们想什么，我们就会成为什么。
The power of imagination makes us infinite.
想象力的力量使我们无限。
The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
你注定成为的唯一的人是你决定成为的人。
Change your thoughts and you change your world.
改变你的思想，你就改变了你的世界。
The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
未来属于那些相信自己梦想之美的人。
You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
设定新目标或做新梦想永远不会太老。
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
取得进展的秘诀是开始。
You have to learn the rules of the game. And then you have to play better than anyone else.
你必须学习游戏规则。然后你必须比任何人都玩得更好。
Do not go where the path may lead, go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
不要走可能引领你的路，而是走没有路的地方，留下一条痕迹。
The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today.
实现明天理想的唯一限制是我们今天的疑虑。
It's not the years in your life that count. It's the life in your years.
重要的不是你生命中的岁月，而是你岁月中的生命。
You must be the change you wish to see in the world.
你必须成为你希望在世界上看到的变化。
The best way to predict the future is to create it.
预测未来的最好方法是创造它。
The only thing standing between you and your goal is the story you keep telling yourself as to why you can't achieve it.
你和你的目标之间唯一的障碍是你不断告诉自己为什么不能实现它的故事。
Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
生活根据一个人的勇气缩小或扩大。
The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
你生命中最重要的两天是你出生的那一天和你发现为什么的那一天。
Whatever you can do, or dream you can, begin it. Boldness has genius, power, and magic in it.
无论你能做什么，或梦想你能做什么，开始吧。大胆中有天才、力量和魔力。
The only journey is the one within.
唯一的旅程是内心的旅程。
What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
与我们内心相比，我们身后和面前的东西都是微不足道的。
